notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326020/c228aef5c80d23445efeee3c2767f9cbf2607f1d.jpg[/img]
[i]Hatchling’s first taste of food[/i]

Our biggest update yet! Building off our hatching demo, we’ve now fully integrated hatching into the main game with its own mode. And since hatchlings need to be able to grow up, we’ve added a leveling system where the more you interact with each pet, the more they’ll grow. There are also numerous improvements to the pets’ behavior. Lastly, we’ve updated our environments to make them feel more distinct. Have fun hatching and raising dragons and be sure to share feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/CQNCuQ7Yem]Discord[/url].

[previewyoutube=CLpcSiYk38w;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Play Modes[/b]
[list]
[*]Hatching Mode - Hatch up to 3 eggs at the hatching station
[*]Hatching mode has 4 stages: egg selection, egg incubation, egg hatching and hatchling feeding.
[*]The hatching station has been redesigned.
[*]Currently, other pets do not show up in hatching mode.
[*]Removed Mystery mode.
[/list]

[b]Pets[/b]
[list]
[*]New pet leveling system! You can now help the pets level up and grow by playing, feeding and interacting with them.
[*]Because this is Early Access, [b]*pet levels might be reset in future updates*[/b] and will definitely be reset for the 1.0 launch.
[*]Pets can level up using a statistics-based Achievement system, basically the more players interact with each pet, the faster they’ll grow up.
[*]More tracked pet statistics and achievements will be added over time.
[*]Statistics and achievements are saved periodically so players can help pets grow over multiple sessions.
[*]A future update will make statistics and achievements for each pet visible to the player.
[*]When pets level up, they currently pop in slightly larger using the teleport effect.
[*]Pet hunger is now tied to their characteristics.
[*]Pets other than Beryl can now take naps in Dragon Den and Spring Pavilion.
[*]Pets are a bit more emotional than they used to be.
[*]Pets only scream at you now if they’re really energized.
[*]Pets are now more aware of the environment and will look at the scenery.
[*]Pets no longer constantly knock food from your hand.
[*]Pets have received more flying instruction and now move somewhat more gracefully.
[*]Pets can now try to push each other around.
[/list]

[b]Environments[/b]
[list]
[*]Renamed Spring Park to Spring Pavilion.
[*]Renamed Beast Park to Summer Dome.
[*]Renamed Winter Park to Winter Cave.
[*]Spring Pavilion had been redesigned as a giant tent with new tree platforms and fencing.
[*]Summer Dome has been redesigned with windows and new tree platforms.
[*]Winter Cave had its floor color changed to make it darker for better contrast.
[*]Added a usable pet bed to Spring Pavilion.
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*]Bland berries will grow back shortly after they are plucked.
[*]All fruit now takes 3 bites to fully consume.
[*]Added a "What’s New" section to Tabby in the Loading Zone.
[*]Gem tooltips now only show up when gems are looked at directly.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved loading times, particularly for Summer Dome.
[*]Improved analytics and event tracking.
[*]Staggering number of bug fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]

[i]It’s hatching time[/i]

So the plan was to quickly release a hatching demo, but it turned out that hatchlings have physics scaling challenges. Since we needed to overhaul the physics anyways, we implemented a new physical characteristics system to give the pets basic stats to determine their physical abilities as they grow and level up. In the next update, we’ll add a post hatching demo for raising the hatchlings. The hatching demo is only available in Beast Park - Experimental Mode for now.

[b]Experimental Mode (aka Hatching Demo)[/b]
[list]
[*]Experimental mode in this version is an egg incubating and hatching demo.
[*]As a reminder, Experimental mode is available in Beast Park after completing Treasure Hunt. It is also the right most option in the initial quick start for returning players.
[*]Step 1: Select one of three new dragon eggs to hatch.
[*]Step 2: Place the egg on the incubator stand, then press the button to incubate.
[*]Step 3: Place the egg in the bed to hatch.
[*]Step 4: Say hello to your new hatchling.
[*]Step 5: Share any feedback on the demo or the hatchlings on our discord!
[/list]

[b]Pets[/b]
[list]
[*]New pet Characteristics that are tied to movement and abilities.
[*]Strength - affects pushing, lifting capacity and size.
[*]Perception - affects detection range, speed and accuracy.
[*]Reflexes - affects catching, dodging and reaction speed.
[*]Endurance - affects size, hunger and stamina.
[*]Agility - affects movement speed and acceleration.
[*]Dexterity - affects biting, grabbing and precision.
[*]Improved dragon physics to function at a wide range of size/age/level.
[*]Increased pet mass to be more in line with their size.
[*]Pets are less likely to knock food from your hand.
[/list]

[b]Play Modes[/b]
[list]
[*]Small improvements to quick start choices, added random free play modes.
[*]Added a time limit to Mystery mode in case markers can’t be found.
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*]Lowered music volume in Winter Park.
[*]Minor improvements to plushie physics in Dragon Den.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved loading times, especially for Beast Park.
[*]Improved analytics and event tracking.
[*]Serious number of bug fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for v0.59.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29326020/c0e9c311c6a8925c947178ef3fc010809f03fe22.jpg[/img]
[i]Gotta relieve stress where we can in 2020[/i]

2020 has been quite the year, but in spite of all the craziness, we’re still pushing ahead with Beast Pets to bigger and better things. Speaking to that, we’ve been hard at work nailing down what it’ll take to make Beast Pets a complete game and exit early access. We’ll be sharing that roadmap in a future update but we can say that we’ll be making a push to get to 1.0 in the next few months. As for changes in this update, we’ve completely redone the pet personality system so that each pet’s distinct personality comes across in all their behaviors. There’s still a long way to go until the pets are as expressive as we’d like them to be, but the foundation is now in place so that in the near future each pet will feel distinct and special.


[b]Pets[/b]
[list]
[*]Complete overhaul of the pet personality system with more changes to come!
[*]Changed pet core personality traits to CHIEF (Curiosity, Helpfulness, Impulsiveness, Expressiveness, Friendliness).
[*]Pets now have personality profiles that manifest themselves in a wide variety of behaviors from attention span to respect for your personal space.
[*]Curiosity (familiarity <-> curious): interest in familiar vs new things; affects attention, awareness, novelty.
[*]Helpfulness (selfish <-> nurturing): willingness to share or consider others; affects sharing, interacting with toys, social behaviors.
[*]Impulsiveness (disciplined <-> impulsive): attention and focus, engagement in entertainment/fun; affects attention, interests, randomness.
[*]Expressiveness (reserved <-> emotional): acting out feelings, emotional sensitivity; affects emotions, vocalizations, dramatic behavior.
[*]Friendliness (anti-social <-> social): interest in others; affects social distancing, social attention, social interactions.
[*]We’re still fine tuning personality expressions so expect more behavioral changes in future updates.
[*]Fixed a bug where pets would ignore each other, not sure how we missed that...
[*]Improved pet memory.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Preliminary support for Oculus Quest 2 via Oculus Link.
[*]Improved analytics and event tracking.
[*]Soul crushing number of bug fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29326020/0899602006ebe10ffd52fbf93aa98c9c59ef8182.jpg[/img]
[i]Meal time![/i]

We’ve been busy overhauling the food system this past to make feeding the dragons as delightful as possible. Tons of other changes under the hood to allow for more interactivity going forward.

[b]Food[/b]
[list]
[*]There are 3 new types of foods in Beast Park: Bland Berries, Pointy Peaches and Spiny Squashes.
[*]Bland berries - Plentiful but not very satisfying, they grow on low bushes and are orange in color.
[*]Pointy Peaches - More pointy than a normal peach and more flavorful, they grow on short trees in bunches (try breaking off a whole bunch instead of grabbing them one by one).
[*]Spiny Squash - These grow on vines and have large spiny shells that need to be cracked open with the orange laser to get to the super delicious bits inside.
[*]All the foods will splat if they get bumped too hard, try not to make a mess.
[*]You can take a bite out of food by holding it up to your mouth, but make sure to save some for the dragons.
[*]All the new foods take 2 bites to eat and show their half-eaten state after one bite.
[/list]

[b]Dragons[/b]
[list]
[*]Dragons get happier when they eat yummy food.
[*]Dragons are now more food motivated.
[*]Dragons can become full now and are no longer have bottomless pits for stomachs.
[*]Dragons become less interested in food once they’re full.
[*]Dragons can now eat food without picking it up first which means they can eat from your hand.
[*]Dragons are much less likely to hesitate getting close to small balls and foods.
[/list]

[b]Beast Park[/b]
[list]
[*]Replace the trees in Beast Park with newer versions.
[*]Retired the block berry vines from Beast Park.
[*]Added new food and plants to Beast Park.
[/list]

[b]Mystery[/b]
[list]
[*]Set the max number of markers to 10.
[*]Moved the marker on top of the trees so it’s more visible from the ground.
[/list]

[b]Foraging[/b]
[list]
[*]The dragons are hungry and need to be fed! Help feed all the dragons with food growing nearby!
[*]Instructions for each type of food appear after teleporting to the nearby marker and disappear once that type of food has been picked up and eaten (by you or a dragon).
[*]Currently only available in Beast Park. 
[/list]

[b]Magical Tablet (Tabby)[/b]
[list]
[*]Tabby is now invisible and untouchable by everything except you.
[*]Adjusted the pet force field on Tabby to discourage pets from getting too close.
[*]Improved grabbing and pointing interactions.
[*]Added new food entries to help section.
[*]Mode selection now includes Foraging.
[*]Changed some quick start options to show foraging mode in Beast Park.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]It is now possible to teleport with a hand that is also grabbing something.
[*]Hands point and un-point better when trying to touch a gem with your finger. 
[*]Improved analytics and event tracking.
[*]Tons of bug fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]

[*]Added more stages to tutorial for smoother onboarding.
[*]Spaced out appearance of gems and dragons so fewer things are happening at once.
[*]Shrunk some dragons down by 5% and changed their appearance order.
[*]Added throwing balls to the tutorial -- grab the ball and place it in your pocket by following the connected lines to make unlimited copies you can throw.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Added teleport ring effect on the ground after teleporting.
[*]Adjusted sensitivity of wrist flick for switching powers.
[*]Added faint arrows if hand is not held still enough.
[*]Moved the controller gaze tracking center to the center of the palm for switching powers.
[*]Improved analytics and event tracking
[*]Various bug fixes and performance improvements
[/list]
